resources.string: Open Ava using your accessibility shortcut, assistant gesture, home widget, or an optional Nothing Essential Key. Avenire checks app and window metadata against capture exclusions before taking a frozen preview; browser toolbar metadata identifies ordinary pages and excludes private tabs and sensitive sites. Page bodies and form fields are not read. Private tabs, excluded apps, locked screens, and ambiguous windows are not captured. Opening Ava keeps the preview on this device. With Share screen with Ava enabled, Send shares the permitted preview with Ava for explanations and annotations. A second capture press requests the full accessible webpage or an original file granted by the current app through Android’s default assistant. In supported document apps, it reads sharing control labels and opens Send a copy or Share; you choose the destination and complete any export steps. Share the original explicitly when the app does not provide it. No continuous recording.
